title: I built a free site to discover the games people are making
author: An4rcyst
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I made [PostYourGame](https://postyourgame.com/), a free site that brings together games shared by their creators on Reddit and other platforms.

The idea is to make those projects easier to find without digging through old posts. You can browse by genre, see screenshots and gameplay, and find play or download links when available. Each imported post credits its author and links back to the original.

It includes mobile, browser and desktop games, from early prototypes to finished releases. If you’re making something, you can also submit your own game for free.

I’m still improving it, and I’d appreciate your honest feedback: does this help you discover projects you’d otherwise miss? What would make you come back?

Hope you find something interesting to try!
